intro: Manage is where you set your truck up and see how it’s doing. The Dashboard is where you take orders and run each event as it happens.

menu.title: Menu
menu.body: Your dishes, prices and allergens. Change anything here and it’s live straight away.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Where and when you’re trading. Add an event here and customers can order for it.

build.title: Deals and Extras & upsells
build.body: Deals, upsells, customisations and your kitchen capacity live under Menu — have a play around.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Your truck’s details and how customers pay.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Where your plan, billing and feature information lives.
